description: Save or remove a channel's maximum published quantity per SKU after preview_channel_stock_limit. Send the SAME platform and maxQuantity (null removes the ceiling), with that preview's token copied verbatim. A stale, expired or mismatched preview is refused: preview again and show the new result. Requires settings:write (owner/admin over OAuth or an explicitly scoped token) AND the workspace owner's AI marketplace-writes switch, off by default. Saves the rule, audits it, expires caches and schedules bounded stock delivery to this channel; remaining products reconcile through scheduled sync. Never changes physical stock, channel membership, paused products or armed write directions. Confirm with the person after showing the preview. Echoes the workspace.

maxQuantity.description: Maximum published quantity per SKU on this channel. Positive integer; null removes the ceiling. Availability after reservations remains the upper bound. Never changes physical stock.

previewToken.description: Copy verbatim from preview_channel_stock_limit for the SAME workspace, platform and maxQuantity. Expires after 15 minutes; preview again after a conflict.

name: set_channel_stock_limit
title: Set channel stock limit
